assets.prompt: Create an original premium editorial commerce illustration for LetBuyy's public website. Transparent background with genuine alpha; no ground rectangle, no full-bleed backdrop, no text, no letters, no logos, no floating UI dashboard, no circular orbit diagram, no neon glow, no plastic 3D. Art direction: sophisticated hand-drawn architectural pen-and-ink lines, subtle gouache color washes, warm ivory objects, midnight navy outlines, restrained lavender and teal accents, realistic product proportions and material texture. Clear immediately understandable visual story, cohesive objects on a subtle isometric tabletop composition, generous 8% transparent margins, landscape 4:3 framing. The screen and real merchandise clearly connect the physical business to its new online store. This is one integrated vignette, not a collage.
assets.semantics: Decorative: adjacent headings, descriptions and lists provide the information.

assets.prompt: Create one original premium editorial illustration for LetBuyy's 'What does that mean for your day?' section. It must visually communicate a small business owner handling everyday online-shop work, not a decorative abstract object. Transparent background with genuine alpha, no background rectangle, no text or lettering, no brand logos, no UI chart clouds, no orbit diagram, no neon glow or plastic 3D. Match an established pen-and-ink/gouache commerce illustration family: precise navy ink outlines, tactile subtle watercolor/gouache washes, warm ivory, midnight navy, restrained muted lavender and teal, natural human proportions and realistic product materials. One Indian woman shop owner in a navy overshirt sits at a compact worktable reviewing a laptop with simple order rows and a small green check without text; next to her is an open kraft parcel holding a folded navy T-shirt and a small product card, and a tidy short stack of stock boxes. Show her comfortably engaged with the laptop, hands natural and anatomically correct. A simple leafy branch is acceptable to soften the composition. A coherent grounded vignette with clear silhouettes and generous transparent margins, no busy background. Landscape 4:3 canvas, designed to read at 320 CSS px wide beneath a heading in a website's left column, in both light and dark themes. Keep the owner, laptop and parcel fully visible.
assets.intendedWidth: 240 CSS pixels on phones; up to 340 CSS pixels on desktop
assets.semantics: Decorative shop-owner vignette beneath the everyday tasks heading. Text and task disclosures carry the information.

assets.prompt: Generate an original photorealistic editorial background photograph for a premium ecommerce software website's explanatory order-workflow card. Very wide landscape composition, intended 2.5:1 banner crop. The rightmost 45 percent contains an open kraft shipping parcel with neatly folded midnight-navy cotton T-shirt, ivory tissue paper, a blank matte shipping label and a small wooden packing surface. Show realistic weave, soft paper fibers, believable creases and natural imperfect materials. Slight overhead three-quarter perspective, sophisticated soft daylight, restrained warm ivory/slate/navy palette, authentic independent boutique packing station. Keep the entire shirt and parcel clustered in the right half, with ample top/bottom safety for responsive cropping. The left 55 percent must be clean quiet pale ivory negative space with extremely subtle paper texture, no objects or strong shadows, suitable for separately rendered text. Smooth natural tonal transition between left and right, no division line. No readable text, no letters, no logos, no hands, no people, no stickers or UI, no arrows, no circles, no illustration, no neon, no purple glowing gradient, no plastic rendering. The result should look like high-end commissioned product photography, calm, tactile and credible, not a glossy AI montage. Opaque background.
assets.style: Photorealistic editorial product photography; warm ivory, navy cotton and kraft packaging.
assets.intendedWidth: Card header background; up to 1280 CSS pixels, with a separate 180px image band below the text on phones.
assets.semantics: Decorative background for the explicitly illustrative T-shirt sale. Visible text describes the process. Not an actual customer order or product advertisement.
assets.status: Removed from card at owner request; historical asset retained.
